title: Cellpose
description: Segment cells and nuclei in 2D and 3D microscopy using pretrained Cellpose 3 models (cyto3 and nuclei).

segment.title: Segment cells
segment.description: Run a pretrained Cellpose 3 model (cyto3 or nuclei) on a 2D image or 3D multi-page TIFF/OME-TIFF stack and return the label TIFF and per-cell CSV table.

image.description: One 2D TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG image, or a 3D multi-page TIFF/OME-TIFF stack

model.description: Pretrained Cellpose 3 model: cyto3 for whole cells/cytoplasm or nuclei for nuclear stains

channel.description: Primary channel to segment (cytoplasm/membrane for cyto3, nuclear stain for nuclei), counting from 1

nuclearChannel.description: Optional nuclear channel (1-based) to guide cyto3 cell segmentation; 0 means none

diameter.description: Expected object diameter in pixels (omitted uses the model default: 30 for cyto3, 17 for nuclei)

flowThresh.description: Maximum allowed flow error in 2D (lower keeps stricter masks; 0 disables flow filtering)

cellprobThresh.description: Cell probability logit threshold (decrease to find more or dimmer cells)

minSize.description: Minimum mask area in pixels (2D) or volume in voxels (3D)

do3D.description: Run 3D ortho-plane (YX, ZY, ZX) segmentation on a 3D multi-page stack

anisotropy.description: Ratio of Z spacing to XY pixel spacing for 3D segmentation
